news.title: The Impact of Early Colleges on Postsecondary Performance and Completion
news.summary_en: This article updates findings from a 17-year longitudinal experimental study on early colleges, examining the impact on postsecondary performance and completion.

news.title: Governing The Accelerator: The Case for National Collaboration in AI-Enabled Materials Discovery
news.summary_en: This perspective examines how federally funded research and development centers can close gaps across three domains: data and infrastructure, algorithmic intelligence, and autonomous experimentation.

news.title: The Emerging Digital Battleground: The Critical Factors That Produce Advantage in the U.S.-China Competition for Digital Networks
news.summary_en: Digital infrastructure is now central to the U.S.-China rivalry. The authors identify nine factors that shape competition in global markets and offer five strategic priorities for the United States.

news.title: Infinite Potential—Insights On Artificial Intelligence Loss of Control Across Five Scenarios: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises
news.summary_en: The authors analyze observations from Infinite Potential games with AI loss of control to identify issues, capabilities, and recommendations needed to navigate the potential collapse of social legitimacy, economic stability, and technical control.

news.title: Assessing Chinese and U.S. Technology Diffusion Capacity
news.summary_en: The U.S.-China tech rivalry hinges not only on innovation but also on achieving widespread technological diffusion in the economy. This report examines both countries’ capacity to convert technological progress into sustained productivity gains.

news.title: Infinite Potential—Insights from the European Games: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises
news.summary_en: The authors synthesize observations from tabletop games on artificial intelligence conducted in Europe or with European scenarios and identify the key issues and capabilities that players deemed necessary to navigate AI’s potential adverse effects.

news.title: Mapping Complex Legislation: Applying the RAND U.S. Code Analysis Tool to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
news.summary_en: The authors applied RAND’s U.S. Code Analysis Tool (CAT) to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act as a proof of concept to show how CAT can support rapid statutory triage by identifying which statutory changes warrant closer review.
